newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stock exchange suspends Jeewon.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stock exchange suspends Jeewon.

text.p: The Jakarta stock exchange suspended trading in shares of small-sized Indonesian electronics manufacturer PT Jeewon Jaya Indonesia on Wednesday following a sudden sharp rise, an exchange official said.

"The counter is not liquid and there seemed to be no significant corporate actions. We have contacted the firm to provide information regarding the sudden sharp rise," an exchange official who declined to be named said.
Jeewon was up 200 rupiah at 1,025 rupiah, with around 3.7 million shares traded before it was suspended at around 0405 GMT.
Brokers said the sudden active buying in Jeewon was due to speculative reasons including a possible take-over.
Jeewon was not immediately available for comment.
Jeewon posted a loss of 4.1 billion rupiah in 1996 against a net profit of 2.7 billion rupiah in 1995.
